faq.q: How do I apply for a rental?
faq.a: Apply online through the link on the listing after inspecting. Applications are usually processed within two business days.

faq.q: Do you do free market appraisals?
faq.a: Yes. A sales agent can visit for a free appraisal. Ask for the property address (and their name and number only if you don't already have them), then leave a message for Sophie, who will call back to book it.

faq.q: Can I get the contract of sale?
faq.a: Yes. Get their email (and name if you don't have it yet) and leave a message; the agent sends the contract the same day.
The office is at Shop 4, 21 Wharf Lane, Sydney.
